AfterRay 是怎么记住你一天的
电脑每 10 秒截一张图，同时从系统的辅助功能接口读出你正在用哪个应用、开着哪个文件、看着哪个网页 —— 这比截图便宜得多，也准得多。
这些原始记录会分三层逐级"压缩成人话"：
：你连续做同一件事的一段时间（比如改了 7 分钟同一个文件），自动折成一句话。
：每 30 分钟一格，把这半小时里的片段汇总成一张卡：标题、几条要点、用了什么。没干活的时段就标"空闲"，不浪费算力。
：48 张卡片排下来，你能看到一整天时间去哪了，点任何一张卡都能跳回当时的屏幕画面。
生成卡片分两步：先立刻出一张"事实卡"（用了哪些应用、各多久），不用等 AI；等电脑接电、空闲时，再让 AI 深入分析，把卡片升级 —— 比如认出"这半小时其实在同时修三个 bug"，甚至发现你每周重复做的流程，问你要不要记下来。
隐私上三条底线：一切都在你自己的电脑上算，数据加密存本地；我们会记录你"做了复制、粘贴到了哪"这类动作，但
绝不记录你打的字、复制的内容
；密码管理器完全不采集，识别到密钥、令牌这类东西会在入库前抹掉。
和 OpenAI 那类方案的区别：他们只记"你做了什么操作"，传到云端处理，事后回不去当时的画面。我们全部本地处理，而且随时能拖回任何一秒，亲眼看到当时的屏幕。

lines: AfterRay records what you see and hear on your Mac, and turns it into memory you can rewind, search, and build on — with AI that runs entirely on-device. No cloud. No account. No exceptions.

lines: feat(cli): serve lody MCP over daemon HTTP instead of per-session std…
Each session's agent runtime previously spawned a dedicated

Node process — a full CLI bundle (measured 250-410MB RSS each) whose only job is proxying MCP tool calls back to the daemon over the local control socket. With N parallel sessions that is N such processes.
Agents whose ACP initialize response advertises
(builtin Claude and Codex adapters both do) now receive an HTTP MCP server entry instead, served by the daemon itself:
: loopback-bound streamable-HTTP endpoint in stateless mode, one transport per request, random bearer token, per-session context (session/workspace/machine/workdir) in request headers. Started from
alongside the other local listeners; never fatal — on failure agents keep stdio.
; session context now resolves through an AsyncLocalStorage override with the existing env-based read as the stdio fallback. Tool surface is unchanged.
prefers the HTTP endpoint when the agent advertised support, otherwise keeps the existing stdio config unchanged (Kimi/Grok/registry agents).

Security: the bearer token travels in the agent's MCP config, which is world-readable via /proc cmdline on Linux, so the daemon additionally resolves the connecting peer's uid from /proc/net/tcp{,6} and rejects a positively identified foreign uid. macOS/Windows hide other users' process arguments, so the token suffices there.
Verified: tsc --noEmit clean, esbuild dev build clean, MCP server suite (40 tests) and new /proc/net/tcp parser tests pass.
